rationale: The assistant correctly identified the cracked and rounded coupler as the cause after sensible tray and roller ring checks, and asked for the model number. It made no false compatibility claim. The final turn was weak: it only said no catalogue match was found and gave no practical guidance, such as searching for an R272WM turntable coupler or noting that it is a cheap clip-on part. The first reply was also a vague, awkward question. Escalating to an engineer for a simple coupler swap is slightly over-cautious, though it did point to the manufacturer or a parts supplier.
